segments.name: Marketing services
segments.description: Connects Brands with Creators for campaign and optimization services, and earns advertising revenue from content published on social media platforms.
segments.evidence: The marketing services operating segment reflects the Company's business of marketing services from clients and social media platforms.

segments.name: Social commerce
segments.description: Buys products from Brands and resells them to Creators so they can build their own eCommerce businesses, and sells some products directly to customers.
segments.evidence: Social Commerce Model : We purchase products from Brands and re-sell them to Creators to help Creators build their own eCommerce businesses.

revenueModel.text: Brands pay a fixed service fee per campaign, YouTube and Facebook pay advertising revenue, and Creators and customers pay for resold products.
revenueModel.evidence: Brands pay us a fixed and pre-determined service fee per campaign.
